record.summary: Apart from the listed accepted deviations, the render matches the reference: header, New project button, card frames, titles, menu buttons and tab bar have the same sizes and spacing, and the third card is fully visible only because the tiles are shorter.

accepted_deviations.as_given: New project shows as the frame draws it and does nothing: making a project is increment four, as it needs a back-end script for the brain and the folders (d-133, f-008 increment one, Out of scope).
accepted_deviations.note: The button is the same size and colour as in the frame. A static image cannot show what it does.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Edit details shows in each card's menu and does nothing: editing a project's details is increment four (d-133).
accepted_deviations.note: The menus are closed in both pictures.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Pin icon. The library has no pin icon, so a pinned card shows the 16 px pill "Pinned" after its name, which keeps the name's line height, so its name and purpose sit level with the other cards' (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Pin icon).
accepted_deviations.note: A "Pinned" pill comes after NCC-1701 in place of the pin icon.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Tile. The letter tile is shorter than the frame's and its letter is the heading style, smaller than the frame's; no token has the frame's height or letter size (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Project tile).
accepted_deviations.note: Each tile is about 100 px tall against about 150 px in the frame. Because of this, the whole third card (omni) shows above the tab bar.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Purpose. The purpose is a bodySm paragraph in the card's meta row, as the library's Card description shows only one or two lines (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Card description).
Purpose wraps. The purpose is bodySm (13/20), whose glyphs are about 4 % narrower than the frame's (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Purpose text style), so each two-line cut ends at a later word than the frame's.
accepted_deviations.note: NCC-1701's purpose ends at "plus the..."; Pinpoint's line breaks match the frame's.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Unpin. A pinned card's menu says Unpin in place of Pin to top. No frame draws a pinned card's menu.

Owner's name. NCC-1701's purpose starts "The owner's personal workspace" in the state file, where the frame has the owner's name: the secret scan's personal-term rule keeps the name out of web/. The live home shows the brain's own words.

Cards heading. A heading "All projects" that only a screen reader reads sits between the page title and the cards, so the heading levels go 1, 2, 3 (the stories' accessibility check). No frame draws it.
accepted_deviations.note: Nothing visible is between the title and the first card.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Tab bar. The tab bar is the app's shared one in the default order (d-105): Home, Inbox, Workspaces, Projects and More. The frame draws Inbox, Workspaces, Projects and More.
Top. The header starts 40 down, the largest spacing token; the frame starts it lower.
accepted_deviations.note: The title and the New project button are about 15 px higher than in the frame.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Cut purpose. Each purpose is cut at two lines with an ellipsis, as the frame cuts NCC-1701's and Pinpoint's; the rule check's hiddenOverflow finding on the cut is in exceptions.json.
accepted_deviations.note: The render ends each cut with an ellipsis. The frame cuts without one.

limits: The reference cuts off the third card under the tab bar, so I could not check its name and purpose against the render's "omni" card.
The small background dots are in different places in the two pictures. They look like a random starfield, so I did not report them.
